name: oraculo-radiohead
description: Market Oracle MCP — real market state for AI agents (Aleph Hackathon 2026)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @oraculo/market-core && npm run build -w @oraculo/mcp-server && npm run build -w @oraculo/wdk-bridge && npm run build -w @oraculo/demo-web
scripts.dev:mcp: npm run build:core && npm run start -w @oraculo/mcp-server
